page-1.name: Dashboard View
page-1.description: A comprehensive dashboard showing key financial metrics including total balance, recent transactions, and spending by category.

page-1.name: Transaction List
page-1.description: A scrollable list of all financial transactions with filtering and sorting capabilities by date, amount, and category.

page-1.name: Add Transaction
page-1.description: A form for adding new financial transactions with fields for amount, date, category, and description.

page-2.name: Budget Planning
page-2.description: Tools for setting monthly budgets for different categories and tracking spending against those budgets.

page-2.name: Reports View
page-2.description: Visual reports and charts showing spending patterns, income trends, and category breakdowns over time.

page-2.name: Export Data
page-2.description: Functionality to export financial data to CSV or PDF formats for external use or record keeping.
